claim: The demo loads and resets to a complete score, ready to play
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert the bundled eight-bar sample renders in the first phone viewport, then edit and reset it

claim: ABC Score Play is free and needs no account
sandbox: fresh home context; assert the free fact, no password input, and no purchase or sign-in action

claim: Your score stays in this browser
sandbox: fresh demo context; edit the score, assert demo localStorage, and reject cross-origin requests

claim: Demo edits stay separate and are discarded when you leave
where: demo banner, privacy page, README, demo guide
sandbox: fresh context; seed a real score, edit demo data, exit through every internal route and Start for real, then assert demo storage is removed and the real score is unchanged

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh demo context; load once, wait for the service worker, set offline, reload, and assert the rendered score

claim: A valid ABC score plays through browser audio
sandbox: fresh demo context with instrumented Web Audio; assert resume, oscillator creation, and oscillator start plus visible play and stop states

claim: One or more selected bars repeat until stopped
sandbox: fresh demo context; choose bars 2–3 at 220 BPM, observe both highlighted measures, two completed passes, and the stopped state

claim: Practice tempo runs from 40 to 220 beats per minute
sandbox: fresh demo context; set each endpoint and values just outside it, then assert the controls retain endpoints and clamp the outside values

claim: The staff updates as you type
sandbox: fresh demo context; replace the source with a distinct valid tune and assert changed SVG, title, and valid state

claim: Opens an ABC file without uploading it
where: Open ABC file action and README
sandbox: fresh demo context; open a fixture, assert exact source and rendered title, demo-only persistence, and no cross-origin request

claim: Downloads the exact ABC source as a safely named .abc file
where: Download ABC file action and README
sandbox: fresh demo context; edit source, download it, and assert exact bytes plus a safe .abc filename

claim: A copied score link restores the score
where: Copy score link button and README
sandbox: fresh demo context with clipboard permission; copy, clear demo storage, reload fragment, and compare source

claim: Print score card opens a clean print view
where: Print score card button and README
sandbox: fresh demo context with window.print captured; emulate print media and assert notation stays visible while navigation and editing controls are hidden

claim: ABC errors point to the line to fix
where: how it works and editor error state

where: real editor Load sample score action
sandbox: fresh real editor with a distinct score; click Load sample score and assert exact source, eight-bar render, enabled playback, and real storage

claim: Clear editor removes saved text only from the active editor
where: real and demo Clear editor actions, privacy page

sandbox: fresh demo context; click rendered bar three and assert both loop endpoints, summary, and status name bar three

sandbox: fresh demo context with instrumented Web Audio; focus score paper, press Space, assert oscillator start and playing state, then press Space and assert stopped state
